Traced prepareNoProjectChatScratch and prepareManagedEngineWorkspace through the shared Windows root preparation and isStationChatFolder recognition. New Windows folders use the canonical profile and Station-home hash; POSIX and recorded conversation cwd remain unchanged. Each created component rejects links and verifies real containment. External workspace backup/retention is documented. Focused consumer tests passed 161/161; independent constant-hash injection failed isolation and restored green. Live fresh-root relative execution supports the placement diagnosis but candidate release/reboot remain unverified.
